LIVE business — ISOLATED branch, compile-verify only, do NOT build deploy-images / touch running containers / restart, no Mongo writes to prod.

## Access (SAFE method — never print the plaintext password)
ssh2/sftp to .200 via the platform approach (decrypt `server.rootPasswordEnc` for server id `cmsc9l72y000ghl7iyd87u5ja`; mirror lib/sftp.ts; use ssh2-sftp-client for uploads if stdin streaming hangs). ASSERT `hostname -I` contains 51.79.226.200 before EVERY command. Worktree off the LATEST integrated branch (so it's a superset that includes the 5 Ideas features + the live web/auth work): `git -C /opt/soulpilates worktree add /opt/soulpilates-wt-notes -b feature/client-notes origin/deploy/sp-ideas-live` (git fetch first).

## Understand first
The client profile: `SoulPilates.Astro/src/pages/admin/client-profile.astro` and its `ClientController`/`ClientService`, the Mongo `Client`/`Clients` document, and how staff auth/identity works (so a note can record who wrote it). Mongo is schemaless — no migration.

## Build — a dated notes/comments log on the client profile
- **Model:** store notes on the Client document as an array of `{ id, text, authorId, authorName, createdAt }` (or a small `ClientNotes` collection keyed by clientId — your call; subdocument array is simplest). `createdAt` = server UTC timestamp.
- **Add note:** `POST /api/client/{id}/notes` (staff-authenticated) — appends a note with the current staff user's id/name + timestamp. Validate non-empty, cap length (e.g. 4000 chars).
- **Delete note:** `DELETE /api/client/{id}/notes/{noteId}` — the note's author OR an Admin can delete it. (Edit is optional — include if quick, otherwise skip.)
- **UI:** a "Notes" card/section on the client profile that reads like a **comments feed**: a textarea + "Add note" button at the top, then the notes listed **newest first**, each showing the note text, the **author name**, and a **formatted date/time** (studio-local). A delete (🗑) control on notes the current user may remove. Style to match the existing profile cards (sp- classes). This is internal staff notes — not visible to the customer.

## Rules & finish
- Compile-verify in throwaway `--rm` containers (NO deploy-image build, NO restart): `dotnet build SoulPilates.API -c Release` in `mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0` → 0 errors (ignore pre-existing SoulPilates.Tests stub errors); `npm ci && npm run build` in `node:22-alpine` → success. No Mongo writes.
- Commit to `feature/client-notes`, push origin (verify the push stuck — the box resets branches; re-push if needed). Remove the worktree + prune.
- Board (Nxeon DB on THIS box /opt/nxeon): CREATE a card on the Soul Pilates board (boardId `cmsavfvil000hhla4nlpuyge6`) in the In progress column (`cmsavfvin000khla4anofdbxt`), title "Dated notes on client profile", type FEATURE, + a "Claude" comment (what built, model, endpoints, branch/tip, deploy note). Clean up helper scripts.

Report: the notes model + endpoints, the permission rule for delete, files changed, dotnet + astro build results, the branch tip, and the exact prod deploy command: `cd /opt/soulpilates && git fetch origin && git checkout -B main origin/feature/client-notes && scripts/deploy-prod.sh` — and note this branch is a SUPERSET of deploy/sp-ideas-live (deploying it ships the 5 Ideas features too, if not already deployed).

**Notes model** (schemaless, no migration): added `public List<ClientNote> Notes` to the `Client` Mongo document. New `ClientNote` subdocument = `{ id (ObjectId), text, authorId, authorName, createdAt (server UTC) }`. Writes use targeted `$push`/`$pull` only — never a full `ReplaceOne` — so no server-managed client state can be clobbered.

**Endpoints** (on `ClientController`, inherits `[Authorize(Policy="Module:clients")]`):
